values.binNote: No bin calculation directly outputs the minion-reduced numbers; the wiki derives them as LuluQ#TotalDamage (base and AP ratio) multiplied by LuluQ.MinionMod=0.7. Stated numbers equal that product though no single bin row carries them.

mechanics.claim: The ability fires two separate bolts (Lulu's and Pix's), each dealing its own instance of damage, with the second bolt dealing reduced damage.
mechanics.quote: '''Lulu''' and ''{{ai|Pix, Faerie Companion|Lulu|Pix}}'' each fire a magic bolt towards the target point, each one dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit

mechanics.claim: Damage against minions is reduced to 70% of the normal value.
Effects (including the damage) occur at the end of the cast time, from wherever the caster is at that moment; Pix fires from his own position at the moment of cast.
mechanics.quote: ''Pix'' fires his bolt from wherever he is when '''Lulu''' casts ''Glitterlance''. '''Lulu's''' bolt will fire from wherever she is at the end of the cast time.

mechanics.claim: Hits apply an 80% slow that decays over 2 seconds; this does not affect damage.
